extension.description: Browse and play music from Navidrome with scrobbling support
extension.news: v0.7.0 (Navidrome 0.64) - Fix: every track of a playlist is scrobbled, not only the first (#8) - Fix: now-playing uses the playbackReport extension correctly (pause/stop shown) - Fix: Similar Songs reads sonicSimilarity results correctly - New: up to 3 accounts with a main-menu switcher (#7) - New: Navidrome multi-library picker - New: Top Songs per artist - New: "Show Track Numbers in Title" now works
